start: Settings, Reminders page, Workout reminders off, Android phone, notifications allowed

user_sees: Title 'Reminders'
Row 'Workout reminders' with caption 'A quiet reminder on your usual training days, at your usual time.'
must_not: A gym switch shown when no gym is joined

user_sees: Seven day circles and a time button appear, first filled with the member's usual training days and time
Caption 'Next: <day and time>. None on a day you already trained or while a workout is open.'
must_not: The switch flips back off
A caption 'Couldn't set reminders. Try again.' when the reminder was set

steps.action: Tap a day circle to add or remove that day
user_sees: The circle fills or empties; the 'Next:' line moves to the right day
must_not: The next reminder set on a day that was just removed

steps.action: Tap the time button and pick a new time
user_sees: The button shows the new time; 'Next:' shows the new time
must_not: The reminder still rings at the old time

start: Reminders page, a gym joined, 'Reminders from my gym' on

user_sees: Row 'Reminders from my gym' with 'Your plan ending, birthday wishes and other news from <gym>, at 9:30 am. Never more than one a day.'
must_not: The row missing for a member with a gym
Another gym's name in the caption

user_sees: The switch shows off
must_not: A plan-ending or birthday reminder from the gym still pops up after it is off

user_sees: The switch shows on; if Android blocks notifications, 'Notifications are off for MettleUp' and 'No reminder from your gym can arrive. Turn them on in your phone's settings.'
must_not: Two reminders on one day after switching on again

start: Reminders page, a gym joined, 'Messages from my gym' on

steps.action: Look at the row 'Messages from my gym'
user_sees: Caption 'Get a pop-up when <gym> sends news, like a holiday, new timings or an offer. It can take a few minutes to reach you.'
must_not: The row shown with no gym joined

steps.action: Turn it off, then have the gym send a message
user_sees: No pop-up arrives; the message still waits in the Gym tab
must_not: A pop-up from the gym while the switch is off
The message lost from the gym inbox because pop-ups are off

steps.action: Tap every filled day circle until none is left
user_sees: Caption 'Pick at least one day.'
must_not: A 'Next:' line with no day picked
A reminder still ringing on a removed day

steps.action: In Android settings, block MettleUp's notifications, come back
user_sees: Caption 'Notifications are off for MettleUp, so no reminder can arrive.'
Button 'Turn on notifications'
must_not: The page still saying 'Next:' as if a reminder will arrive

user_sees: The phone's notification settings for MettleUp open
must_not: Nothing happens
The app closes

user_sees: Only 'Workout reminders'
must_not: 'Reminders from my gym' or 'Messages from my gym' shown with no gym
An empty card where a gym row was

start: Reminders page, a gym joined, both gym switches on, workout reminders on

user_sees: Caption back to 'A quiet reminder on your usual training days, at your usual time.'; the day circles and time button hide
must_not: A workout reminder still rings after it is off

user_sees: The days and time picked before come back
must_not: Days reset to the usual slot after the member picked their own days

steps.action: Turn 'Reminders from my gym' off then on
user_sees: Off: no gym reminders; on: the gym's reminders set again
must_not: Reminders from before 'off' come back twice

steps.action: Turn 'Messages from my gym' on and allow notifications
user_sees: The switch is on
must_not: The phone's push address sent to the server while the switch is off or no gym is joined

user_sees: The switch is off
must_not: The gym can still pop up messages on this phone
The push address sent to a gym the member left
